title: Albion
summary: Albion the Dragon Slayer is a Titan with a largely human appearance having gray armor, blue hair, and pale skin. His weapon is a golden sword which is attached to his armor by a energy thread. He is an immensely loyal Titan who can resist attempts at mind-control. This Titan was lent to Sophie by her butler, LeBlanche, in order to aid her in the coming battle against the Professor before being returned to him.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The very image of a medieval knight, Albion's combat prowess was imitated by innumerable kings and warriors of the ancient world. Though few knew it at the time, these armored fighters owe Albion for introducing the foundations of their martial arts.

In the modern age, Albion came into the possession of LeBlanche and became his most powerful Titan. [S1E24]

LeBlanche lent Albion's Amulet to Sophie Casterwill for the battle against the Professor. [The Secret of Two Generations] Albion proved himself useful against Araknos and was vital in Sophie's survival, with his fierce loyalty being able to resist Araknos' Mastermind ability. After a fierce battle, however, Albion was defeated by Behemoth. [The Mission]

Later, Albion was returned to LeBlanche. He was invoked alongside Sentinel to save Sophie from the magical traps of the Crystal Caves. [Cave of the Casterwills]

LeBlanche invoked Albion on Avalon to fight Wilder's forces. Albion helped buy Zhalia time when she attempted to re-invoke King Basilisk. He fought and defeated Hoffman's Redcap. [Knight of the Willblade]

LeBlanche invoked Albion to assist the Huntik team in rescuing Focauld Casterwill. The team used Albion's energy thread to reach Focauld where they fought Kiel and Marduk. Albion attacked Kiel's Ignatius before being defeated by Marduk's Cerberus. [The Casterwill Connection]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E30 Albion Redcap.jpg|thumb|Albion can make use of his sword's energy thread in combat]]
Albion is well versed in combat. He primarily relies on a golden sword connected to his armor by an energy thread, this allows him to perform both close and long range attacks. This energy thread can be used to bind opponents {{Source|Knight of the Willblade}} or another grand variety of tasks, including being detached to act as a rope. This thread can remain standing even after Albion himself is sent back to his amulet {{Source|The Casterwill Connection}}. Albion also has a natural resistance to mind control such as Araknos' due to his Fierce Loyalty ability {{Source|The Mission}}, although he has a natural loyalty to members of the [[Casterwill family]]. {{source|TCG:LGS-005|LGS-005}}
